title: Biology.
description: Develop a deep understanding of biological systems from molecular processes to ecosystems, with strong emphasis on application, data analysis and required practical skills.

sections.title: Biological Molecules
sections.text: Carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, enzymes, nucleic acids, ATP and water. Focus on structure-function relationships and biochemical testing.

sections.title: Cells and Ultrastructure
sections.text: Prokaryotic vs eukaryotic cells, organelles, microscopy, cell division, transport mechanisms and membrane structure.

sections.title: Exchange and Transport
sections.text: Gas exchange systems, mass transport in plants and animals, haemoglobin and circulation.

sections.title: Genetics and Gene Expression
sections.text: DNA replication, transcription, translation, mutations, epigenetics and genetic engineering.

sections.title: Energy Transfers
sections.text: Photosynthesis and respiration pathways including the light-dependent reaction, Calvin cycle and oxidative phosphorylation.

sections.title: Homeostasis and Control
sections.text: Nervous coordination, hormonal control, feedback mechanisms and immune response.

sections.title: Evolution and Ecosystems
sections.text: Natural selection, speciation, biodiversity, population genetics and conservation biology.

sections.title: Practical Endorsement
sections.text: Independent investigation, statistical testing, graph interpretation and scientific evaluation.
